description: This file defines the ExtendedSpringLiquibaseFactory class, a Spring component responsible for creating configured instances of ExtendedSpringLiquibase for database migration management, integrating Liquibase properties, resource loading, environment profiles, and a database-aware migration context.

classes.name: ExtendedSpringLiquibaseFactory
classes.description: A Spring component class responsible for creating ExtendedSpringLiquibase instances with proper configuration for database migrations.

methods.name: ExtendedSpringLiquibaseFactory
methods.description: Constructor that initializes LiquibaseProperties, ResourceLoader, Environment, and DatabaseAwareMigrationContextProvider dependencies.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates and configures an ExtendedSpringLiquibase instance based on data source, provided contexts, and environment settings.
